                              Career money

                              Recomputed from the payout ledger's yearly columns, 2014–2026 buy-ins included (the sheet's own Total column stopped updating after 2023). Championship and runner-up money = season payouts by finish (the 2014 runner-up, Cliff, per the commissioner — the ledger predates its finish columns); weekly = top-score money at that year's rate ($20 through 2025, $40 since). Shared-seat money is split by year to whoever held the seat (Austin: seat-A 2014–15 + seat-B 2024+; Alex: 2016; Luke: 2017+; Neville: 2014–23). 2026 winnings land after the season.

                                  Verdict

                                  Every source is redraft — no dynasty values, so age and rookie premiums don't distort win-now trades. FantasyCalc is computed for this league's exact settings (12-team, 1 QB, 0.5 PPR redraft) and its curve prices the rank-based sources: ROS Consensus = Dynasty Daddy's rest-of-season consensus rank (ESPN/FantasyPros/FanDuel aggregate, provider-default scoring), FantasyPros ECR = their half-PPR rest-of-season expert consensus, each valued at what FantasyCalc pays that rank at the position. Sleeper VOR and ESPN VOR = rest-of-season projected points above a replacement-level starter (12-team lineups), so positional scarcity counts everywhere; ESPN's 0.5 PPR is the mean of their standard and full-PPR projections. The verdict averages each player's share of the top value in every source that lists them. — = not listed by that source.

                                  Draft report card (2015–2026)

                                  Value = player's season points minus the average return for that draft slot and position, within that season. ESPN-era values use official season totals under that year's scoring.

                                  Draft outcomes

                                      Top-60 picks only.

                                      Every pick, every draft

                                      ESPN-era (2015-2019) points = points scored while in a starting lineup. Sleeper-era value = points vs the average for that slot.

                                      Season luck meter

                                      All-play = your record if you played everyone every week. vs Median = your record against each week's league median score. Luck = actual wins minus expected wins from your scores — positive means the schedule has been kind.

                                      Schedule simulator

                                      Each row: that team's record if it had played the column team's schedule (their own scores, the other guy's opponents). Diagonal = actual record. Green = better than reality, red = worse.

                                      Career luck

                                      Lucky W = wins with a bottom-half score. Unlucky L = losses with a top-half score.
